name: db-wasm
description: A lightweight local file-based database module for WASM, storing data in localStorage with full CRUD operations
author: Ben

changes: Added insert, update, and delete operations
Added import database from JSON with merge/replace options
Added database statistics (entries count, storage size)
Added silent mode for console logging
Comprehensive error handling with structured responses

errorHandling.description: Database module returns objects with 'success' field. Check success=true for valid operations, success=false with 'error' field on failure
errorHandling.detection: if (!result.success) { /* handle error: result.error */ } else { /* use result.data */ }

features: Full CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
Support for multiple data types (string, number, boolean, objects)

functions.name: createDatabase
functions.description: Create a new database or open an existing one

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the database to create/open

functions.returns: Object with success status, message, and database info

functions.name: insertData
functions.description: Insert or update a key-value pair in the database

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to store (string, number, boolean, or object)

functions.returns: Object with success status and inserted data

functions.name: getData
functions.description: Retrieve a value by key from the database
functions.returns: Object with success status and retrieved value

functions.name: deleteData
functions.description: Remove a key-value pair from the database
functions.returns: Object with success status and deleted key

functions.name: listKeys
functions.description: Returns all keys in the database
functions.returns: Object with success status, array of keys, and count

functions.name: getAllData
functions.description: Returns all data in the database
functions.returns: Object with success status, all data, and count

functions.name: clearDatabase
functions.description: Removes all data from the database
functions.returns: Object with success status and deleted count

functions.name: deleteDatabase
functions.description: Removes the database entirely from storage

parameters.name: dbName
parameters.description: Name of the database to delete

functions.name: exportDatabase
functions.description: Exports the database as JSON string

parameters.name: dbName
parameters.description: Name of the database to export

functions.returns: Object with success status and JSON data string

functions.name: importDatabase
functions.description: Imports data from JSON into the database

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: If true, replaces all data; if false, merges with existing data (default: false)

functions.returns: Object with success status, imported count, and total count

functions.name: getStats
functions.returns: Object with database statistics (name, entries, storage size)

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: True to enable silent mode, false to disable
